title: Wire startup flow and degraded states in main.js
description:
js/main.js: loadHikes, render Score-sorted cards immediately, then fetch weather and drive times in parallel, then rank and re-render. Subscribe list to store. Implement Loading / HikesOnly / Ranked / Error states.

Acceptance: offline load still shows all cards sorted by Score with a notice; broken hikes.json shows an error message; screenshots of Ranked and offline states.

From docs/plans/0001-hiker-web-app.md, section "Key Flows".
